conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: DD Form 1391 — 275,400 GSF total building area
conflict_flags.rationale: 275,400 SF is the total floor area of the building per the authoritative government project document. 148,219 SF is the building footprint (per-floor area), not the total. The occupant load sum of 276,133 SF is a close-enough match to 275,400 (difference likely reflects exclusion of basement from occupant load but inclusion in total area). No material conflict.

BOD introduction says 'The existing building is NH65 at the Naval Station Norfolk' — this is a clear typographic error; all remaining BOD content, all SAES content, and all DD Form 1391 content consistently refer to NH95. No substantive conflict.
